description: This file implements the ARCv2 ARC CONNECT driver, providing functions for inter-core communication, interrupt management, core reset/halt/run, and global counters in an ARC processor environment.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_generate
methods.description: Generates an inter-core interrupt to the specified core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_ack
methods.description: Acknowledges an inter-core interrupt from the specified core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_read_status
methods.description: Reads the status of inter-core interrupts for a core.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_check_src
methods.description: Checks the source of the inter-core interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_ici_clear
methods.description: Clears the inter-core interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_reset
methods.description: Resets specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_halt
methods.description: Halts specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_run
methods.description: Runs specified cores.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_mask_set
methods.description: Sets the core mask.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_mask_read
methods.description: Reads the core mask.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_select_set
methods.description: Sets cores to be halted if the issuing core is halted.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_select_read
methods.description: Reads the select value.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_en_read
methods.description: Reads the system cores' halt/run status.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_cmd_read
methods.description: Reads the last command sent.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_debug_core_read
methods.description: Reads the internal MCD_CORE register.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_clear
methods.description: Clears the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_read
methods.description: Reads 64 bits of the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_enable
methods.description: Enables the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_disable
methods.description: Disables the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_core_set
methods.description: Sets cores for the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_halt_read
methods.description: Reads the halt status of the global free running counter.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_gfrc_core_read
methods.description: Reads the internal CORE register related to GFRC.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_enable
methods.description: Enables the interrupt distribute unit.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_disable
methods.description: Disables the interrupt distribute unit.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_enable
methods.description: Reads enable status of the IDU.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_mode
methods.description: Sets trigger and distribution mode for a common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_mode
methods.description: Reads mode of a specific common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_dest
methods.description: Sets target cores for a specific interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_dest
methods.description: Reads destination cores of a specific interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_gen_cirq
methods.description: Asserts a specific common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_ack_cirq
methods.description: Acknowledges a specific common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_status
methods.description: Checks status of a specific common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_source
methods.description: Checks source of a specific common interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_set_mask
methods.description: Masks or unmasks a specific interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_read_mask
methods.description: Reads mask of a specific interrupt.

methods.name: z_arc_connect_idu_check_first
methods.description: Checks if the core is the first to acknowledge a specific interrupt.
